title: Model manifest + compatibility validator for embedding and reranker onboarding
creator: Lena Thompson
description:
Problem: We onboard several embedding and pairwise reranker artifacts weekly. Current onboarding is ad-hoc: model metadata is scattered (S3 manifests, PR notes, spreadsheets) and manual checks for tokenizer/quantization/latency profiles cause regressions or delayed publish. Goal: introduce a canonical model manifest specification and a compatibility validator that runs as part of CI to gate publishing of performance profiles and pin decisions for embedding and reranker artifacts.

Scope: canonical manifest schema (JSON) for embedding + reranker artifacts; a lightweight validator service (CLI + CI step) that verifies schema, tokenizer fingerprint match, quantization compatibility, minimum eval metrics (recall@k/ndcg for rerankers, similarity cosine/precision for embeddings), latency smoke checks on small instance types, and presence of profile artifacts (profile.json, metrics CSVs, example prompts). Add automation to the profile-publish pipeline so a successful validation flips the model to published state and optionally applies a pin window.

Non-goals: replacing full benchmark infra, re-training models, or running full-scale throughput jobs in validator. This is a fast pre-flight gate intended to catch integration problems and obvious quality regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) manifest schema v1 defined and checked into infra repo (README + JSON schema)
2) CLI validator that returns non-zero exit code on schema or fingerprint failures and produces human-readable failure messages
3) CI pipeline stage added to model publish workflow that runs validator on candidate artifacts
4) profile publish job only marks profiles as 'published' when validator passes; failed validations show failure reasons in the publish UI
5) unit tests for schema checks and integration test that runs validator against three example artifacts (good, tokenizer-mismatch, slow-latency)
work_log: 2026-03-10: Kickoff meeting with PM and Research. Agreed scope and non-goals. (Lena)

2026-03-11: Drafted initial manifest fields and draft JSON schema. Focus fields: model_id, version, tokenizer_hash, quantization, variant, eval_metrics, profile_artifact_s3, pinned_until, allowed_fallbacks. (Marco)
2026-03-11: Ran quick scan of last 30 onboarding PRs to extract common metadata and mismatches; tokenizer_hash missing in ~40% of artifacts. (Aisha)
2026-03-12: Prototype CLI validator that checks schema + tokenizer hash lookup against tokenizer service. Basic latency smoke test using smallest GPU instance completes. (Marco)
2026-03-12: Created PR for schema + CLI: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5423 (WIP). Added CI job placeholder. (Marco)
comments: Aisha Patel (2026-03-11): Important to include 'quantization_bits' and 'quant_backend' in schema so we can route incompatible variants to fallback models automatically.

Daniel Cho (2026-03-12): For rerankers we need to assert that eval_metrics include eval dataset name + seed; otherwise it's hard to compare. Also suggested including 'anchor_prompts' sample for quick manual sanity checks.
Sofia Mendes (2026-03-12): UX note — publish UI should show validator errors inline and provide a link to a replay job for latency failures. Creating a small follow-up ticket for UI changes.
